(5) The trim tool inserted a ## 2026-09 month header into CHANGELOG.md; the ## 2026-08 header above it still heads older 2026-09-dated entries — a pre-existing cosmetic mislabeling (entries dated 2026-09-* sat under ## 2026-08 before this session); leave it unless a session is tasked with it.
